## Post-Analyze Consistency

> 验证 analyze 修正后 spec 内部交叉引用与措辞的一致性

- [ ] CHK059 After SUPERSEDED cleanup and FR-015/FR-003a consolidation, are all intra-spec cross-references (e.g., FR-002 → FR-015, FR-014 → FR-003a, SC-005 → FR-016) still pointing to valid requirement IDs with correct semantics? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-015, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK060 Is FR-002's reference to "FR-015" for continuation rules still unambiguous after FR-015 was shortened to reference FR-003a for the enumeration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-003a]
- [ ] CHK061 Does SC-005's indirection to "FR-016 最小文档清单" preserve the complete document update scope, or does the indirection risk losing track of the full list during a future edit? [Completeness, Spec §SC-005, Spec §FR-016]

## Filter Bypass Requirements Precision

> CC-003a 硬约束：network_requests 的占位与续读必须复用 filter/sanitize 边界

- [ ] CHK062 Are the requirements for `network_requests` filter enforcement during `read_field_chunk` specified with enough precision to distinguish "must route through sql_rewriter/FilteredDuckDBConnection" from a weaker "must not raw-read" constraint? [Clarity, Spec §CC-003a, Plan §Constitution Check II]
- [ ] CHK063 Is the routing between filtered-read (`network_requests` via sql_rewriter) and parameterized direct-read (other `StableLocatorRule`-covered tables) specified in the requirements as a hard per-table constraint, or left as an implementation-level decision? [Completeness, Spec §CC-003a, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Constitution Check II]
- [ ] CHK064 Are requirements for what happens when `network_requests` filter rules change between placeholder generation and later chunk read specified clearly enough — does the spec mandate re-validation of filter boundaries on each `read_field_chunk` call, or is this left implicit? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011 Edge Cases, Spec §CC-003a]

## Migration Completeness

> 旧 12KB 截断路径 → 新占位+续读机制的完整切换

- [ ] CHK065 Is the requirement to completely remove `_MAX_QUERY_CELL_CHARS = 12_000` specified as a hard cutover with no fallback path, so a reviewer can grep for the constant and assert it no longer exists? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, Tasks T014]
- [ ] CHK066 Are requirements for any edge cases that the old 12KB truncation handled but the new threshold-based replacement does not (e.g., binary columns, NULL values) documented as consciously excluded or explicitly covered by the new path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK067 Is the requirement that ALL text columns trigger placeholder replacement (not just known large-field columns) stated without any implied field allow-list, so a reviewer can reject code that gates on a hardcoded field name list? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Clarifications 2026-04-23 final Q]

## Error Path & Blocked Continuation Coverage

> 9 error codes + 4 read_blocked_reason 的需求完整性和无歧义性

- [ ] CHK068 Are all 9 `error.code` values each associated with a unique, non-overlapping trigger condition, so no input scenario could legitimately produce two different codes depending on validation order? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §ChunkReadError codes]
- [ ] CHK069 Are all 4 `read_blocked_reason` values each associated with a distinct detection condition, with the boundary between `ambiguous_locator_source` and `missing_locator_field` clearly delineated (same-name column from different tables vs. column entirely absent)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003a, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK070 Is the requirement for `error.code` as a searchable structured-log dimension (SC-006) specified with concrete log field names or at least a naming convention, or does the implementer need to invent the log schema? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Spec §CC-008]
- [ ] CHK071 Are error response shapes for "record deleted after placeholder was issued" (`record_unavailable`) vs "record filtered out by noise rules" (also `record_unavailable` vs a different code) distinguishable through requirements-specified error codes, or is this distinction left to implementation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §CC-003a]
